title: On the Iterate Convergence of Bregman Projected Gradient Method
summary: The iterate convergence of \textit{Bregman projected gradient method} (BPGM) has remained a long-standing open problem, especially for the widely adopted Shannon entropy kernel. Existing convergence results are often limited, relying on Lipschitz continuity of the kernel's gradient or restrictive conditions on the objective function. In this paper, we develop a novel convergence analysis framework for the BPGM with the Shannon entropy kernel, yielding strong convergence results for a broad class of objective functions under linear constraints.
